capacityStage: A: frozen 12-layer backbone plus existing V3 heads
selection: authorized V3 DEV only; otherwise all ten epoch checkpoints eligible, none selected
loss: sum of mean cross-entropies for six token, five fixed sequence, five primary pointer and one temporal anchor outputs; -100 ignored; no class weighting or repetition
ambiguityLoss: Weight 1 conditional negative log probability mass of the plausible alternative SET among real candidates, on AMBIGUOUS fields only. Primary remains UNKNOWN. No uniform probability or preference ranking is imposed; order retained in evidence. No extra neural head.
featureAdapter: Frozen encoder contextual means for observation mention spans; encoded typed descriptors for reserved speaker/observer, context surface forms and temporal anchor kinds/spans. Opaque entity IDs, semantic role labels and statuses never enter input embeddings. Teacher-forced TRAIN claim/mention/temporal spans only.
implementationNotes: No executable Student-5 numerical optimizer configuration was registered. These fixed run parameters instantiate canonical capacity stage A; Student-4 configuration and repair weights are not reused.
Use CP41/CP44 verified torch 2.4.1+cpu and transformers 4.44.2 environment rather than the generic ARCHITETTURA dependency suggestions; exact installed versions are recorded.

Cache FP32 frozen encoder states in eval mode. Existing head operations are reproduced exactly and checked against original model forward before any optimizer step. Training dropout remains 0.1 on heads.
Batch cropping removes padding only. Pointer special indices are remapped from unpadded candidate count to fixed slots 16 and 17. Immutable stored targets are not rewritten.
No early stopping, DEV substitution, automatic escalation or second training round. Loss diagnostics are TRAIN fit only and cannot select or establish generalization.
